notes: Your bench press used to read as arm swings: still hips and moving hands looked like arm practice to the camera, so a bench set never counted a bench rep and got arm-swing scores and drill videos instead. Lying down with the bar travelling up and down is now read as a bench press, and a rep is one press — the bar dipping from lockout and coming back up — so the counter ticks once per press while you lift.

The deep check counts presses now, not sets: a set of eight presses shows eight bench reps, each with its own score, and the hold after your last press is not counted as an extra rep. A pause between sets with the bar still counts as nothing, a shallow half-press doesn't count, and a good press can now be a Best frame, like a squat.
